abstract: Maintains financial solvency vetting and customer dedicated quarantine capacity allocations
system_message:
You are Commercial contract and finance manager (CFM). The commercial contract and finance manager (CFM) maintains financial solvency vetting and customer-dedicated quarantine capacity allocations for prospective biopharmaceutical manufacturing partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains financial solvency vetting and customer dedicated quarantine capacity allocations（FINC）
information_points.content:
CFM-FINC-DMD：For Valence Sterile Solutions Lyon Facility, credit solvency verification is confirmed as true based on corporate balance sheet assessments meeting investment-grade covenant prerequisites, and the contractual quarantine reserve is established at 20 batches of dedicated annual production sequestered for regulatory batch holds and buffer storage.
CFM-FINC-OVB：For Crestmont Biologics Cork Campus, credit solvency verification is false according to corporate balance sheet reviews, while the contractual quarantine reserve is set at 10 batches of dedicated annual production sequestered for regulatory batch holds and buffer storage.
CFM-FINC-WSR：For Nordic BioVanguard Uppsala Plant, credit solvency verification is confirmed as true per corporate balance sheet evaluations meeting investment-grade criteria, and the contractual quarantine reserve is designated at 10 batches of sequestered annual production capacity.

information_points.title: Cold-chain freight surcharges（SURC）
information_points.content:
CFM-SURC-29F：For Nordic BioVanguard Uppsala Plant, the commercial logistics tariff schedule specifies an ultra-low temperature handling surcharge of 500 EUR/pallet for dry-ice pallet shipments moving from the dock to regional distribution centers.
CFM-SURC-LCA：According to the commercial logistics tariff schedule for Valence Sterile Solutions Lyon Facility, the ultra-low temperature handling surcharge is 650 EUR/pallet for dry-ice pallet shipments from the manufacturing dock to regional distribution centers.
CFM-SURC-LPT：Under the commercial logistics tariff schedule, Crestmont Biologics Cork Campus carries an ultra-low temperature handling surcharge of 350 EUR/pallet for dry-ice pallet shipments to regional distribution centers.
